name: create_goal
description: Create one persisted /goal completion contract when the current direct human request is a long-running objective that should continue across autonomous goal-mode rounds. You may infer that intent without requiring the user to say "create a goal". Do not use this for trivial single-turn work, and do not use it while a host-verified /ultragoal is open. Execution rejects non-human and subagent authority.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

reason.description: 为什么必须调用此工具而不是直接回复？

description.description: 一句话说明这次调用在做什么。
